azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.description: Assess the declared public IPv4 network configuration of each selected registry. Fail for enabled public access with default Allow or an allow-rule union covering every IPv4 address; report trusted Azure service bypass separately.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.fail_observation: The registry declares enabled public access from every IPv4 address through default Allow or its combined IP allow rules. Authentication and effective access were not tested.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.missing_observation: Complete, bound registry network declarations were unavailable or unsupported. Public IPv4 restriction could not be assessed.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.pass_observation: The registry declares public access disabled, or default Deny without IP rules covering every IPv4 address. Trusted-service bypass and effective access require separate review.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.purpose: A default-Deny registry with VNet declarations can still allow the whole Internet through its IP rules. This check covers that separate configuration gap.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.remediation: Disable public network access, or use default Deny with only the IPv4 ranges needed by registry clients. Review trusted Azure service bypass separately.
azure.network.acr_public_ip_ranges_restr.title: ACR public network rules do not allow every IPv4 address
